title: Glossier You Fleur Eau de Parfum
descriptionHtml:
✓ Fresh Scent✓ Layerable Scent✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent

Fragrance Family: Fresh

Scent Type: Fresh Florals

Key Notes: Ylang-Ylang, Apricot Skin, Ambrox

Fragrance Description: Glossier You Fleur is an airy and luminous floral blended perfume. This fresh scent opens with a salty Mineral Salt Accord, leading into a heart of velvety Apricot Skin and an exquisite blend of new blooms—fuzzy Osmanthus and creamy Ylang Ylang— accented by woody Cashmeran, all balanced by a warm, musky base driven by Ambrox.

About the Bottle: The bottle is an objet d’art in its own right. Crafted in house at Glossier, it features the actual thumbprint of its designer.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

- Spray scent as desired on your pulse points (your neck, behind your ears, your wrists, and more) 

- Allow fragrance to settle for a few moments rather than rubbing it in (as this can disrupt the scent) 

- Apply post-shower, after moisturizing to aid absorption for a longer, stronger scent impact

Ingredients+
Alcohol Denat., Water/Aqua/Eau, Fragrance/Parfum, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Benzyl Salicylate, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Cananga Odorata Oil/Extract, Santalum Album Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Linalool, Hydroxycitronellal, Coumarin, Vanillin, Geraniol, Hexadecanolactone, Geranyl Acetate, Santalol, Beta-Caryophyllene, Pinene, Limonene, Rose Ketones.
